title: Selling models
content:
Hello,

I am a fashion designer and I would like to know how to sell my own models through the CLO-SET platform. Could you please explain the practical steps required to register as a seller and upload designs?

I would also like to understand the basic requirements for independent designers, as well as how rights and financial returns are managed.

Thank you in advance to anyone who can provide information or share their experience.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. You can find all of this information in the Help Center 🙂https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/66f88e4221f84f65837ef9eb8e78fa65

Comment 2: hello, love. I am not part of the clo team but i am pretty sure that you simply have to make a clo connect account. Then make/upload you items made in clo3d. (So i am assuming that those are the 3d clothes/designs/etc) You go to upload>store> and you will see a break down on pricing and how you will receive the amounts and such~
content_description: This web page provides independent fashion designers with practical guidance on registering as sellers, uploading designs, and understanding rights and financial returns on the CLO-SET platform.
